android.esc.at.note: Starts with an at sign (a resource reference to aapt2).

android.esc.markup.note: An ampersand and a greater-than sign.

android.esc.percent_args.note: A percent sign with arguments, and format-looking text.

android.esc.question.note: Starts with a question mark (an attribute reference to aapt2).

android.esc.quotes.note: Quotes, an apostrophe and a backslash.

android.esc.shadow.note: Argument names that could shadow names in the accessor.

android.esc.spaces.note: A no-break space and narrow no-break spaces.
